messages:
arya: quick design check: updated autoscale card in figma (frames: pool-dialog-v2, minmax-stepper, slo-cost-chip). Main asks: pool switch UX, fallback opt-out wording & placement, stepper keyboard semantics. rapid feedback appreciated. :pray:
ben: skimmed it. pool switch modal looks fine but we need to avoid language that implies instant routing. suggest header 'Switch route to pool' and subcopy 'New requests will target the selected pool. Existing requests may finish on the previous pool while connections drain.'
lina: +1. Also add a small progress line after confirm: 'Applying change  draining  remapping' with estimate '~202s'. show a spinner + role=status for screen readers.
oz: can we include an ephemeral undo in a snackbar that says 'Revert pool switch'? backend supports a short-window rollback if no config drift happened. recommend 90s.
a11y-bot: accessibility notes: 1) stepper should be role="spinbutton" and expose aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow. 2) Increment/decrement must be real buttons with aria-labels like 'Increase max instances'. 3) Progress messages should use role="status" and aria-atomic="true". 4) cost preview chip should be aria-live="polite" and only update when user changes slider.
arya: copy for fallback opt-out: current label 'Disable fallback' feels terse. propose 'Prevent automatic fallback' with help text: 'If enabled, requests may be throttled or return errors when burst capacity is exhausted.' place in advanced settings.
lina: we should also have a short inline badge for fallback events: concise toast: 'Burst unavailable  using backup capacity.' expanded message in activity log: 'Route X used Pool Beta due to burst limit; policy=latency-first.'
ben: visual nit: fallback badge color collides with warning in other screens. prefer an outlined/neutral badge with a refresh icon and reserve orange for errors.
oz: stepper keyboard: when focused arrows +/- should increment, Home/End jump to min/max, pageUp/pageDown step larger. ensure preventDefault only when spinbutton focused.
a11y-bot: tooltip for SLO slider must be keyboard-focusable and connected via aria-describedby. add a short accessible description: 'Lower latency increases cost.' and expose a cost delta preview text for screen readers.
arya: agree. I'll update figma: change modal copy, add progress state, include snackbar undo, move opt-out to advanced settings, and annotate spinbutton + slider with aria notes.
ben: i'll implement the front-end refactor: replace divs with buttons for steppers and wire key handlers.
lina: i'll update copy doc with microcopy short/long variants for toasts and activity log examples.
a11y-bot: checklist added to the task: spinbutton semantics, aria-live for cost preview, role=status on progress, keyboard-focusable tooltip, accessible labels on toggle.
arya: thanks team. aiming to land these tweaks in next sprint; please drop any remaining comments on the Figma frames. :white_check_mark:
